answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the tundra of a task receipt, and the inlet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the yarrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
